label: Finding-79
title: leak-hn: 3 smaller precision and sourcing points
description: Screenshot 'came down' not carried: Daubois: 'A screenshot of the PHP2Shell tool, credited to Calif.IO, leaked alongside the advisory, and a short exploitation video went up and came down the same way.' Only the video is said to have come down. Also Daubois writes 'Calif.IO', not 'Calif.io'. | Note's quote of The Hacker News is not verbatim: The capture reads 'a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit leaked ahead of time'; the note drops '(PoC)'. The Foundation's phrase is capitalised 'No technical details leaked.' in the source. | Uncited corroboration available: Huntress, CybelAngel and Equixly (all in the manifest) independently describe the removed Hacker News post; citing them would lift this above a single personal blog.
